title: Open Robotics RViz PointCloud2Display PointField Out-of-Bounds Read Denial-of-Service Vulnerability. (CVE-2026-134045)
description: A denial-of-service vulnerability exists in Open Robotics RViz due to improper validation of PointCloud2 message data, allowing out-of-bounds reads. Network-adjacent attackers can exploit this without authentication to cause a denial-of-service condition.
